gloss: wild; wildlife; growing in the wild

definitions.gloss: wild; wildlife; growing or living in the wild
definitions.explanation: The state of animals or plants living naturally without human cultivation or domestication. Also used as a modifier to describe something that exists in its natural, untamed state.

examples.japanese: {野生|やせい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{鹿|しか}→鹿：04347_shika⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{見|み}かけた→見かける：01644_mikakeru⟧。
⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{花|はな}→花：00523_hana⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{野生|やせい}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{育|そだ}った→育つ：01951_sodatsu⟧ものだ。
examples.english: This flower grew in the wild.

examples.japanese: {野生|やせい}⟦{動物|どうぶつ}→動物：01480_doubutsu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{餌|えさ}→餌：01886_esa⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{与|あた}えて→与える：01821_ataeru⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧いけない⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{看板|かんばん}→看板：00166_kanban⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{書|か}いてあった→書く：00477_kaku⟧。
examples.english: A sign said that you must not feed the wild animals.

notes:
A compound of {野|や} (field, wild) and {生|せい} (life, living). Used both as a noun and as a no-adjective modifier.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {野生|やせい}⟦{動物|どうぶつ}→動物：01480_doubutsu⟧ (wild animal)
- {野生|やせい}⟦{植物|しょくぶつ}→植物：03248_shokubutsu⟧ (wild plant)
- {野生|やせい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧～ (wild ~)
- {野生|やせい}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{返|かえ}る→返る：29164_kaeru⟧ (to return to the wild)
- {野生|やせい}⟦{生物|せいぶつ}→生物：03295_seibutsu⟧ (wildlife)

The opposite of {野生|やせい} is ⟦{飼育|しいく}→飼育：06422_shiiku⟧ (breeding, raising in captivity) for animals or ⟦{栽培|さいばい}→栽培：13108_saibai⟧ (cultivation) for plants. {野生|やせい} can also be used figuratively to describe someone with raw, untamed energy or instincts: {野生|やせい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{勘|かん}→勘：02149_kan⟧ (wild instinct).
